name: Echo Arena
detailed_description:
Survive endless battles!

This is a 3D top-down dual-stick shooter roguelike game where you'll fight your way through a hostile world, repelling waves of enemies with precision shooting and maneuvering. At the end of each battle, you can choose to enhance your abilities and create a unique fighting style. Stick around long enough and you'll win!

Core Gameplay

- Fast-Paced Combat -- Intuitive dual-stick shooting system lets you shoot and dodge as you go, adjusting your tactics on the fly.

- Upgrades and Growth -- Choose from multiple upgrade options after each round of combat to enhance your attributes and shape your fighting style.

- Unique Visual Style -- Mobius style artwork creates a sci-fi and fantasy world, bringing you a unique visual experience.

- Diverse Enemies -- A variety of enemies and elite units with different characteristics make the battle full of challenges.

- Progressive Challenges -- Each round is more dangerous than the last, testing your reflexes and strategic choices.

More Highlights

- Randomness and replay value -- Experience different weapon combinations and upgrade paths with each playthrough.

- Easy to learn, hard to master -- Whether you are a novice or a hardcore player, you can find your own battle rhythm.

- Extremely smooth operation -- The movement and shooting mechanism is finely polished, making the battle full of excitement.

If you like the fusion of roguelike, survival shooting and tactical upgrades, this game will bring you an intense and tense combat experience. Can you survive the tide of enemies?

Join the wishlist right now and get ready for the challenge!

pc_requirements.minimum:

  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or equivalent AMD or better
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics（Intel HD Graphics 4000 or better）
  • DirectX: Version 10

pc_requirements.recommended:

  • Memory: 4 MB RAM

  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 100 GB available space
